newsitem.title: USA: FX Energy is drilling well in Poland.
newsitem.headline: FX Energy is drilling well in Poland.

text.p: FX Energy Inc said Monday it has set surface casing and is drilling the Orneta 1 well on its 2.4 million acre Baltic Concession in northern Poland.
This is the first well to be drilled in Poland by a western independent oil and natural gas company testing for oil, FX said. RWE AG is the joint owner of the well.
The Orneta 1 is planned to test a Middle Cambrian sandstone at a depth of about 8,500 feet, FX said.
The company said it expects the well will take 45 days to drill and an additional two to four weeks to test before results will be available.
